name: S5-nano
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B: 8 full GQA layers (kv heads 4, head_dim 256) and 24 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-12 from the HF API (77 likes / 1,249 downloads at crawl). A Brazilian-Portuguese continued-pretraining run of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B by Maritaca AI - same config.json, same 4,659,865,088-parameter tensor set, licence apache-2.0. PARAMS: HF safetensors total 4,659,865,088 (BF16 4,659,861,248 + F32 3,840) = 4.66B, matching the base exactly. The card's own figure is '~4.2B text' i.e. the text tower excluding the 460M vision encoder, which is why the card's comparison table lists Qwen3.5-4B as '4.66B . ~4.2B text'. flops_per_token_active = 2 x 4.66e9 = 9.32e9, inherited from the base record's active count. The repo still ships the inherited vision_config and its HF pipeline_tag is image-text-to-text, but the card presents S5-nano as a text model ('the BF16 version, 9.3 GB'); the vision tower is inherited weight, not new capability, and no image benchmark is printed. WHY IT IS A CONTENDER, NOT A REPACK: the card prints one table with the base's own column beside it, and S5-nano beats Qwen3.5-4B on the Portuguese-native rows by large margins - OAB-Bench 82.00 vs 45.88, Magis-Bench 50.41 vs 13.97, CondutaBench 80.24 vs 67.92, MARCA 89.57 vs 78.23, Prosa-PT 75.07 vs 56.89, MMLU-PT undergraduate 80.54 vs 63.92. WHAT IT LOSES on the same table: IFBench 42.67 vs 49.67, LongBench v2 49.70 vs 54.08, Global-MMLU PT 78.22 vs 81.43, MATH-PT 87.77 vs 91.07, HarmBench 91.25 vs 96.56, plus Arena-Hard v2 19.12 vs base 11.67 is a gain but still far under Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 25.82. So the gains are Portuguese-domain and instruction-heavy, and the regressions are general-reasoning/instruction-following and long context - a trade, not a clean win. HARNESS CAVEAT: vendor-run. The card states sampling matched 'the mode-specific recommendations used for Qwen3.5-4B', context 262,144 with the qwen3 / qwen3_coder parsers, and 32,768 output tokens in Instruct (81,920 for MATH-PT), but prints no harness build. Two modes are published (Think and Instruct); the rows recorded here are the THINK table because it is the default mode and the one with the 23/23 coverage. The Instruct table is a second, partly different comparison set and was not recorded. The card also flags that some models produced reasoning in Instruct mode even when disabled (marked with a dagger), so its Instruct numbers are not clean either.
